accessibility.contrast: Ensure coral text and borders meet at least 4.5:1 ratio against cream backgrounds. Use text-shadow if needed over gradients.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to all icon buttons (mic, send, close, toggle).
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-coral-400 focus:outline-none for interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a standalone React + Tailwind CSS widget (not the whole portfolio).
The component must render a 'Floating Trigger' initially (a circular button with animated curved text 'Ask Pinky' using SVG textPath and a soft coral aura).
When clicked, open the conversational interface (Bottom sheet on mobile, floating card on desktop).
Use Framer Motion for opening/closing the chat panel.

Implement the UI with these mocked states: Connecting, Listening, User speaking, Agent speaking, Text conversation, Tool recommendation, Error, Microphone permission, Ended. Provide a way to cycle through these states for demonstration (e.g. debug buttons or a sequential mock flow).
Typography: Use Space Mono for all conversational text, ensuring a distinct 'developer/designer' aesthetic.
User Bubbles: Lavender/light purple background (#E0D8FB), no borders, right-aligned.
Tool Recommendation Cards: Render an 'Absorb Case study' pill with the provided thumbnail URL and an arrow icon.
Voice Mode State: Render a large centered soft pink/coral gradient orb with a waveform (bars) and a stop button underneath.
Error State: Render as a red pill banner with monospace text 'Microphone access is off. Please allow access.'
Include 'Voice' toggle pill and mic button in the text input area.

DO NOT use raw <input type='text'> if it breaks Shadcn UI norms, but for this custom widget, standard React inputs styled with Tailwind are fine. Ensure the text input looks like a pill with a coral border.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
NEVER use universal transition like 'transition: all' globally. Apply transitions to specific properties.
NEVER center align the app container globally.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations & relevant colors.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use generous spacing; cramped designs look cheap.
Use lucide-react for icons (Mic, Send, X, ArrowUpRight, etc.).
